lines.en: label undeservedfuture12:
scene shiori1
: Is that why I need to work today? Because you were slacking off in your little pocket dimension again?
: No. You need to work today because I have made a grave mistake. That mistake just happens to involve said pocket dimension and you’re the only person I can rely on.
scene shiori2
: Please don’t rely on me. Who is this and why is he conscious?
: That’s my dad! Dad, Shiori. Shiori, Dad.
: Uhh...nice to meet you?
: Doumo.
scene shiori3
: You have royally fucked up, Himawari. Surely you understand that without me having to tell you, right?
: That’s why I said you’re the only person I can rely on! You’re the only one who won’t tell on me!
: I assume it’s frowned upon to take your father with you on a job like this?
scene shiori4
: That’s putting it lightly. Extremely lightly. But it’s not like this girl has ever followed the rules in the first place, so I can’t say it’s unexpected.
: I follow some of them! Just...you know, not the ones that potentially interfere with both my loved ones and myself. Which is why I told him basically everything about this place.
: What was wrong with this one again? You talk about it so much that I blocked it from my memory. All I remember is you’re not supposed to be here.
: It’s the one that shouldn’t have ever existed in the first place. With that Maya girl who-
: Oh, right. The unstable one where everyone’s super horny all the time. No wonder I never come here.
scene shiori5
: But you’re here today! Which means you can help us get everything in order before we turn the clock back. Right?
: I don’t know. How badly are you going to annoy me if I back out now?
: That really hinges on whether or not I continue to exist. There’s a solid chance I just disappear for good if he stays here as it would disrupt the-
scene shiori6
: What’s your name?
: At least pretend to be worried about me! Or, at the very least, let me finish my speech.
: Akira Arakawa.
: Interesting.
: Why? Have you...heard it before?
scene shiori7
: No. I just half-expected your name to be stupid too since you named your daughter “Himawari.” Akira’s pretty normal though. It’s fitting for someone so ordinary looking.
: I’m actually a little glad my mom couldn’t come with us. The idea of you insulting my entire family in one fell swoop makes me angry.
scene shiori8
: So, where am I going? How many are there and how many have you found so far?
: One male and thirty-four females total. I’ve only tackled one so far. That number includes Maya, though. And she’s a little harder to take care of than-
: Don’t tell me how to do my job. I’ve been at this longer than you’ve been alive.
: And how long is that exactly?
scene shiori9
: Good luck. She won’t even tell me and I’m practically her best friend. Just look at how long I’ve been touching her without being swatted away.
: A long time. And I have no reason to tell someone I just met, so leave it at that.
: Shiori-Senpai might seem cold, but don’t worry. She’ll put just as much love and care into fixing everyone as me.
: If you trust her, I trust her. And if there’s any way I can help, don’t hesitate to let me know.
: If you really want to help, go hide somewhere until we’re done here. Because, no offense, but all you’re going to do is get in Himawari’s way.
scene shiori10
: Shi-chan, that’s not-
: I mean emotionally.
: I’m sure you’ll finish the job regardless of whether or not he’s here, but I don’t think you’re mentally strong enough to do this alongside someone so important to you.
: Nor do I think he needs a behind the scenes tour of what we do. It’s not like that’s going to help him get out.
: You’re letting your emotions light the way again. I told you that you can’t do that if you really want to survive here.
scene shiori11
: Also, stop calling me Shi-chan. I hate nicknames.
: You hate everything. I never have any idea what I’m supposed to talk to you about.
: Probably because you aren’t supposed to be talking to me at all. We’re supposed to do our jobs and that’s it. We didn’t sign up for this to make friends.
: Why did you sign up then?
scene shiori12
: And that’s not me trying to be facetious. I just...genuinely don’t understand your role or job or anything. Like why do you do this? There needs to be some sort of benefit, right?
: Is the pay just that good? Or...do you get something else out of it? I don’t understand.
: Good. Things are better off that way.
scene shiori13
: That said, if you really want to be helpful, go stand over there for a minute so I can talk to Himawari alone. I don’t want to accidentally short-circuit your brain in front of your daughter.
: Just...over there? By myself?
: Play with that girl’s corpse if you want to. She’s basically just a doll right now anyway.
: Don’t give him any ideas. This is a weird world for him and he is a creature of habit.
scene black
I walk past Sana’s body on the way to the shoreline and try to spot any signs of breathing, knowing I’m better off thinking of her rather than trying to eavesdrop right now.
Unfortunately, as I look off toward the horizon, I think not of the stars or how they mimic the web this world has spun. But I do think of the latest bipedal mystery to appear before me.
And how all I can do is hope that Himawari can handle her a little better than I could ever wish to.
scene shiori14
: Question. Have you lost your fucking mind?
: Maybe. Probably.
: Did I not get it across to you just how serious it is to leave people like him out of this?
: You can’t guide him. No matter how badly you want him to succeed. No matter what rides on that success.
: All it takes is one look from the higher-ups, who are already suspicious of you, to put an end to not just your family, but everyone’s.
: This entire world and all that run parallel to it are now at risk, Himawari. You could all be gone by daylight and no one would ever know.
: And now I’m at risk since you’ve dragged me into this mess too. Do you think I want to die?
: Sometimes, yeah.
: Everybody wants to die sometimes. That means nothing. You get what I’m saying, though. And you’re smarter than this. So stop trying to play God and let him figure it out on his own.
: I don’t know if he will, Senpai. And I know exactly what I’m risking by doing this. It doesn’t change anything.
scene shiori15
: Hah...
: Well, so long as you know you’re being an irresponsible idiot, there’s not much else I can do. It’s not like I’m going to stop you myself.
scene shiori16
: I just hope you’re prepared for what comes next.
: Because you’re barely any different from that wish girl by interfering to this extent. You’re turning this world into your sandbox instead of theirs.
: You already have a world. Go play there. Leave this one to those who can actually do something with it.
: No one’s doing anything with it, though. It’s just suffering...day after day after day. And the longer it goes on, the uglier everything will be when this place collapses.
: I just want to see them be happy. I want my family to be a family. Is that really too much to ask?
: You’ve already asked that and you’ve already received an answer. And you can go there whenever you want, which is far more than most can do. So why hurt yourself like this?
: Because it’s not fair if only they’re hurting.
scene shiori17
: Fucking empaths. You’re all so exhausting.
: Shiori-Senpai, why do you always reset yourself?
: This again? I already told you-
: I know you said that the job is easier when you’re numb, but don’t you think that outlook might change if you actually let yourself feel?
: Yes. You just answered your own question, so thanks. It saves me the work.
: Is there really no one you want to save out there? No one that you want to be with? This you. Not the other ones.
: I wouldn’t have to keep wiping my mind if there wasn’t. But that changes nothing, Himawari.
scene shiori18
: You want to make the world a better place, don’t you? That’s what you’re always daydreaming about when you’re not too busy bragging about your parents.
: How do you expect to do that when you’re putting so many people in danger by just being here?
: I’ll figure it out. I just...need more time.
: No. You need a lobotomy.
scene shiori19
: I’ve said all I need to say, though. I just wanted to make sure you know how much of a reckless idiot you’re being right now.
: Ready to get the ball rolling and probably traumatize your dad and ruin his life in ways you never expected to?

: I was kind of hoping you could handle all of the brutal stuff this time and leave the dolls to me. I told him that was your job because I didn’t want him to know I have to clean up viscera sometimes.
: Then you handle the beach and I’ll go scour the rest of the town. Are everyone’s profiles updated, at least?
: I think so. I haven’t been the one doing it on account of, well...you know. Suspicion.
scene shiori20
: I’m glad your brain is still somewhat functional. One last thing before I go, though.
: What is it?...I don’t know where anyone else is yet if that’s what you’re-
: Just try to enjoy it, okay? It’s possible you never see him again after this.
: Thank you, Shi-chan...
: That really helps.
: No problem.
scene shiori21
: But stop fucking calling me Shi-chan.
scene shiori22
scene black
: Hah...
scene shiori23
: So, uhh...is she always like that?
: Yeah. That’s more or less Shiori-Senpai for you.
: A little rough around the edges, sure. But there’s some gap-moe there if you’re willing to dig deep enough.
: Can’t say I expected your first friend to be some goth girl. The two of you are practically polar opposites.
: I had plenty of friends back in Aomori. I just preferred hanging out with you guys.
: So what you’re saying is you’re a loser.
: Guess so. Everybody always teased me for it back then too. It never really bothered me, though.
scene shiori24
: To be honest, I’ve never really understood that whole “being embarrassed by your parents” thing that it seems like virtually every other teenager has to endure. Perhaps I am just broken?
: Perhaps. I’m not about to try and fix you, though.
scene shiori25
: Wow. That’s probably the first time you’ve said that about literally anybody.
: I don’t think so, to be honest. I feel like my expectation going into a relationship is that I’m going to wind up damaging whoever’s unfortunate enough to engage in one with me.
: Oooooh, so maybe it was you who broke me! Nice. That means I don’t have to feel bad about myself anymore and I can just blame you instead.
scene shiori26
: It’s kind of funny, though. Because apart from expecting to be the one who hurts people, I also expect to be the one people want to fix. And I feel like, most of the time, that’s true.
: But the only person to ever have any success with that is you, I think.
: Wow. It’s almost as if spreading yourself between a million lovers is not a healthy decision. Who’d have thought?
: You know Ami’s basically my daughter too though, right?
: I know she is here. But maybe I just don’t really see her that way since she was just always “Aunt Ami” to me.
: And she was good to you? She never, like...hurt you? Or tried to influence you or anything like that?
: Not once. I really liked her, to be honest. But I kept my distance since I know you and Mom were a little worried about her.
: And seeing how she is here? I completely get it.
scene shiori27
: Everybody’s different here, though. Well...except for Mom, maybe. But I don’t even want to talk about how long it took for me to accept that you were just a bimbo back in the day.
: That was nothing like the you from my memories. So seeing you traipse all over town engaging in illicit affairs with girls my age was, uhhh...kinda really gross.
: Yeah...I’m sorry you had to see that. If I knew-
scene shiori28
: Don’t make it weird and apologize for doing stuff from before I was technically born. All that matters is you stopped once I was.
: Besides, expecting you to act all wholesome and chaste when you wished someone like Maya into existence is just flat-out unreasonable.
: I think I’ve just come to terms with your entire backstory being miserable and perverse by now. And with the help of parental controls, I am now mostly shielded from that!
: Mostly?

: It’s automated, unfortunately. Can’t expect filters like that to catch 100%% of everything. So I just always need to have a bottle of hand-sanitizer nearby so I can dump it into my eyes if I see something weird.
scene shiori29
: This revelation will likely affect my life in a greater way than even meeting you did.
: You’ll cave and that’s not really something you should feel bad about. It’s a part of who you are and an obstacle to overcome.
: I can only imagine how tough that is when there’s a girl walking around who you essentially created. In a way much different from how you created me, of course.
: Maya really is just the physical manifestation of your desire and temptation and pain all wrapped into one little codependent tsundere package, isn’t she?
: She’s not all that tsundere nowadays. Lately, it’s more desperation than anything else.
: I have no idea what I’m supposed to do, honestly.
scene shiori30
: Because if this is her world...and the only way to reunite with you is to somehow break it down, I...
: I will do it. Of course I’ll do it. But that doesn’t mean I’m going to long for a world where she doesn’t exist anymore. I want to keep her by any means possible.
: Any version of her. Because even if it’s not the one who most vividly exists in my memories, she still searched for me for years. Far longer than you have, I imagine.
: Far longer. I’m still new to this, all things considered. And I hope for your sake that I’m wrong and she can come back with you if we wind up accomplishing our goal.
: But again, if something seems like it’s too good to be true...
: It normally-
scene shiori31
scene shiori32
: What are you doing?
: Making you love me more?
: Himawari-
: It’s a roleplaying exercise!
: I’ve learned recently that my Maya impression needs some work. And you don’t yet know how to talk to her about all of this. So now we can both practice!
: You are my daughter and I do not want you wearing the clothes of the girl I created to sate the most evil of lusts that has ever existed. Change back.
scene shiori33
: But Halloween is right around the corner and I never get to dress up for it!
: Himawari...
scene shiori34
: That’s Hima-chan to you, Master. I am a maid now.
: Does making the most of what time we have left really just translate to you tormenting me for the rest of the day?
scene shiori35
: No, but that’s what being your daughter translates to. Annoying you is my god-given right. I just hope it’s one of the cool gods and not a weird, scary one.
: Do I have the god-given right as your father to ground you if you don’t listen to me?
: Only if you want to get another visit from CPS.
scene black
: If everything else about the way you speak and act and look didn’t scream that you’re the same Himawari from Aomori, that right there would have done it immediately.
: Now put your regular clothes back on. I don’t want you dressed as a maid either.
: I actually wore something similar a long time ago and appeared to you while you were on a date. You said I was very attractive and I immediately regretted my decision.
: Please forget that ever happened. I am so sorry.
: I can guarantee you that I want nothing more than to forget it happened as well, Dad.
: Then why are you still dressed as a maid?
: I transformed too many times and the spell is on cooldown now. I am technically a magical girl, you know. There are rules that govern our powers.
: Yeah, well I’d like to see that rule book when you get a chance.
$ undeservedfuture12 = True
jump undeservedfuture13
